entries.grounds: Equivalence holds. lineage.py:173-174 opens `O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)`; the mutant's `getattr(os, "", 0)` is 0. O_NOFOLLOW governs only the final path component, and O_CREAT|O_EXCL already refuses a final component that exists, a symbolic link included, with EEXIST whatever it points at (POSIX open(); macOS open(2); Linux open(2): "symbolic links are not followed: if pathname is a symbolic link, then open() fails"; Linux build_open_flags ORs O_NOFOLLOW in for O_CREAT|O_EXCL itself - recalled, not readable on this host). Re-measured here on macOS / Python 3.14.7: dangling, to-file, to-dir, looping, regular-file and directory final components all give EEXIST (FileExistsError) with and without the flag; an intermediate symlinked directory is followed either way (the flag does not govern it). Where os has no O_NOFOLLOW (Windows) the original is already 0. The only handler is `except FileExistsError` (L175-177). Differential run at the snapshot (original module vs the mutant, claim lifecycle: refusal, supersede by digest, second generation, torn / non-object / run-not-a-string claims, dangling links, anchors written and read): identical on every observable, dangling links included.

entries.grounds: Equivalence holds on the same proof as claim [65]: lineage.py:401 opens `O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)`; O_CREAT|O_EXCL refuses an existing final component, a symbolic link included, with EEXIST (POSIX; macOS open(2); Linux open(2); Linux ORs O_NOFOLLOW in itself), O_NOFOLLOW governs only that component, and the mutant's flag value equals what Windows already gets. Re-measured on macOS / Python 3.14.7: EEXIST with and without the flag for dangling, to-file, to-dir, looping, regular and directory targets; an intermediate symlinked directory is followed either way. The documented promise (ANCHOR-THREAT-MODEL.md:49-50, REPORT.md:234: a symlink, even one pointing nowhere, is refused) is behavioural and is held by O_EXCL; the docs name O_NOFOLLOW as the mechanism but nothing observable depends on it. cli.py:65-66 also refuses an existing or dangling path with os.path.lexists before the run. Differential run at the snapshot (original module vs the mutant, claim lifecycle: refusal, supersede by digest, second generation, torn / non-object / run-not-a-string claims, dangling links, anchors written and read): identical on every observable (dangling link refused with FileExistsError in both).
